title: Gospels and Acts
description: An exegetical study of Matthew, Mark, Luke, John and Acts. Students examine each book's structure, purpose and theology; key passages such as the infancy narratives, the Sermon on the Mount, the parables, the miracles, the passion and resurrection; the historical Jesus debate; and the Spirit-empowered mission of the church in Acts. The course trains students to read the Gospels 'horizontally' and 'vertically' and to preach narrative texts.
